verdict.rationale: Pendo's Leo answers natural-language questions inside the product, lets users build guides and segments in the same conversation, and continuously monitors data to raise in-Pendo alerts when something shifts. Suggested Session Replays and Pendo Predict's churn identification add further in-product AI-driven insights and suggestions. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Leo generates insights and recommendations (beyond marketing copy), independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask questions in natural language and take action by building guides and segments inside the same conversation.
Leo monitors continuously. Get alerts in Pendo and Slack when something shifts -without having to go looking for it.
Suggested Session Replays surfaces the most relevant ones.
Pendo Predict identifies who will churn before they do
